name: Fines (Spain)
description: White field with a blue diagonal band edged yellow rising from the lower hoist, the lower fly blue, charged in the upper hoist with the crowned municipal arms of Fines (a lozengy field on blue).
history: Fines adopted its arms officially on 12 January 1982 and its flag on 24 October 2003; the flag is described as a rectangular cloth of proportions 1:1.5 divided per bend.

features.role: blue band edged yellow rising to the upper fly
